title: My Parents GLOW In The Dark 💡
description:
In our town, you glow while you keep a secret, brighter every day you keep it. Party planners light up like lamps, and nobody plays poker.

My mom and dad have glowed since before I was born. Thirty years of it. Last Friday, at our usual booth, I finally asked them what they're hiding.

It's made up. A blocky story, built with code and Blender.
pin: Comment PIZZA if you'd have kept their secret.
